# margent

## Running margent

<!-- x-release-please-start-version -->
Run `margent --version` once. If it prints `0.7.0`, run every command below as `margent …`.

Otherwise run them as `npx -y margent@0.7.0 …`. It needs Node 22 or later.
<!-- x-release-please-end -->

The rest of this skill writes `margent` for whichever form applies.
